title: Division cycle closing completed
description: This event indicates the completion of the cycle closing for a specific division.

division_code.title: Division code ID
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Unique ID used to identify the division within your organization.

business_date.title: Cycle closing business date
business_date.description: The business date when the cycle closing event was triggered.

cycle_closing_datetime.title: Cycle closing datetime
cycle_closing_datetime.description: The cycle closing datetime indicates the moment the event was issued. Note that the time is displayed in UTC, regardless of the division's local time zone.

next_business_date.title: Next business date
next_business_date.description: The next business date is the cycle closing date

is_holiday.title: Is holiday
is_holiday.description: Is the business date a holiday?

is_weekend.title: Is weekend
is_weekend.description: Does the business date fall on a weekend?
